Remote | Website & App Reviews | Entry-Level Friendly 
 About the Role
 We're looking for a detail-oriented UI/UX Reviewer & Quality Assurance (QA) professional to review websites, landing pages, and web applications to ensure they provide a smooth, intuitive, and consistent user experience.
 In this role, you'll evaluate user interfaces, identify usability issues, check design consistency, and help ensure that digital products meet quality standards before they reach users. You'll work with design and development teams to provide actionable feedback and help improve the overall user experience.
 This opportunity is suitable for individuals who have an interest in UI/UX design, website usability, and software quality assurance. Familiarity with modern design tools and AI-powered productivity tools is a plus.
 Responsibilities

• Review websites, landing pages, and web applications for usability, accessibility, and visual consistency.

• Evaluate user interfaces to identify layout issues, confusing navigation, inconsistent spacing, and design inconsistencies.

• Perform quality assurance checks across different browsers, screen sizes, and devices.

• Identify and document bugs, UI defects, and user experience issues with clear descriptions and supporting screenshots.

• Test key user flows, including registration, login, navigation, form submissions, and other interactive elements.

• Compare implemented interfaces against design references, mockups, and expected functionality.

• Provide constructive feedback and actionable recommendations to improve usability and user satisfaction.

• Collaborate with designers and developers to verify fixes and maintain quality standards.

• Use AI tools and productivity software to support documentation, analysis, and review workflows.

 Requirements

• Basic understanding of UI/UX design principles and website usability.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify visual and functional inconsistencies.

• Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Ability to document issues clearly and provide practical recommendations.

• Familiarity with web browsers, responsive design, and common website interactions.

• Willingness to learn QA methodologies, usability testing, and modern review tools.

• Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks in a remote environment.

 Nice to Have: 

• Familiarity with Figma or other UI/UX design tools.

• Basic knowledge of software testing and bug reporting.

• Understanding of accessibility principles and responsive web design.

• Experience using tools such as Jira, Trello, or similar task management platforms.

• Familiarity with AI-powered tools for productivity and quality assurance.

 What You'll Gain

• Hands-on experience reviewing websites and digital products.

• Practical exposure to UI/UX design principles and quality assurance workflows.

• Opportunities to develop analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience collaborating with remote design and development teams.

• Opportunities to build a portfolio of review work and quality improvement projects.

 Work Arrangement

• Location: Remote

• Job Type: Part-time — specify as applicable]

• Experience Level: Entry-Level Friendly

• Compensation: 35$/hr

 How to Apply 
 If you're passionate about creating better digital experiences and enjoy identifying ways to improve websites and applications, we'd love to hear from you.
 Submit your application with your resume and any relevant UI/UX, website review, or quality assurance experience.
